module: D09-14 Market Share／Entry Barrier／Substitution／Competitive Strategy市占、進入障礙、替代與競爭策略
purpose: Freeze native strategic-action outcome states and prevent announcement/implementation milestones from being mislabeled as investment success.

outcomeContract.unit: issuer × strategic action × lifecycle stage × native outcome clock
outcomeContract.successRule: Success is action-specific and must be defined ex ante in native operational/commercial terms; a press release, award, capex plan or plant opening alone is not success.
outcomeContract.stockRule: No stock-return, valuation or trading interpretation is part of this contract.

nativeOutcome: system deployed to No.2 sinter machine
company reports approximately 4% improvement in sinter production yield
company reports approximately 22,000 tonnes annual carbon reduction
controls.interpretationLimit: Operational milestone success does not establish company-wide margin, market-share or stock-return success.

controls.action: Smart Scrap Inspection System R&D project
nativeOutcome: commercial cost/yield/margin outcome not yet established
controls.interpretationLimit: Active project is neither success nor failure before native completion/outcome evidence.

nativeOutcome: Ohio plant acquisition and manufacturing/joint-development agreements were implemented
additional equity-investment pathway was only partially funded
Foxconn financial reporting states remaining investment was suspended after agreement dispute
Lordstown filed bankruptcy and litigation in 2023; Foxconn suspended subsequent negotiations
controls.source: Foxconn official releases and consolidated financial reporting
controls.interpretationLimit: Negative control applies to the specific Lordstown partnership chain, not Foxconn's entire EV strategy or Ohio-plant capability.

commonSupportLesson: Action-state comparison is possible on lifecycle semantics, but economic outcome metrics are not automatically common across steel process optimization and EV partnership actions.
Do not create a cross-action numeric 'strategy success score' from incomparable native metrics.
A completed operational milestone, an in-progress R&D project and a suspended partnership are valid distinct states without forcing artificial scalar ranking.
falsification: Successful implementation can still fail to create durable economic value.
Delayed projects can later succeed; DELAYED != FAILED.
Partial success can coexist with failure of a later investment/partner pathway.
Counterparty failure is not necessarily issuer execution failure.
One failed action does not imply firm-wide strategy failure.
preregisteredFutureOutcomeLayers: revenue/margin effect on native disclosure clock
only after all above: prospective/OOS stock-selection utility
redundancyControls: No shared observation can be independently voted by multiple domains.
reasonNoL4: Native action outcomes and failure states are now well-defined, but stock-selection predictive efficacy, common financial outcomes, OOS validation, costs and multi-regime robustness remain absent.
exactNext: BR-058 prospectively freeze new strategic actions before outcomes are known, then append native milestone/financial/share outcomes on later publication clocks.
Build at least one comparable within-industry action cohort before estimating relative-position effects.
No scalar strategy-success score or System1/System2 role promotion before common-support and OOS validation.
